summary: Chana LNG Terminal (T100000130893) is confirmed dead: re-verification across Thai/English/Korean press found no revival, FID, or construction; last activity was the March 2021 KOWEPO/KOGAS/TPIPP tripartite agreement, and the parent Chana Industrial Estate was halted by cabinet in Dec 2021 pending a strategic environmental assessment. The inferred-dormancy anchors (proposal 2021 -> shelved 2023 -> cancelled 2025) and cancelled status are correct and unchanged; the Postgres timeline already reflects them, so nothing to stage there. It is a genuine, dedicated marine LNG import terminal (KOGAS-operated LNG tanks/procurement to supply the 1.7 GW Songkhla Chana power plant), not a captive pipe-fed arrangement from an existing terminal, so it is correctly in scope and correctly modeled as a terminal with the power station as AssociatedTerminals. Staged: strengthened Status [ref] to two independent sources (blue re-verify), filled the blank AssociatedTerminals [ref] (green, 3 sources), and replaced the FacilityType [ref] and Location [ref] DOI mis-citation (an unrelated 2005 SPE petroleum paper) with proper sources. Filed 3 qa notes: the DOI link_rot/citation-quality defect, the StartDate [ref] Rule-F orphan (data-health, don't fix), and a low-severity note that the cancellation is dormancy-inferred.
